runtime: a server that started cannot later be talked
into leaking. The class marking is authoritative, and a
type that forgot to declare one counts as egress, so the
omission fails the boot instead of quietly sending audio

An `mcp_servers` entry is the same case and carries the
same field: tool arguments are conversation-derived, and
neither transport settles it, since a stdio command may
proxy anywhere and a URL may name localhost.
The firmware's only tie to a backend is the OTA URL in NVS.
Endpoints, credentials, even the reply language are
delivered by your server at runtime, so customization lives
in Python and not in C++ you have to reflash.
